from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687629/attempts/1a23792c575c414fa559b68921d57662/system/state/workspace')
programs=root/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        # For a row split into a leading stripe and a different-color suffix,
        # recolor the suffix as the marker color 1.
        if len(set(row))>1:
            first=row[0]
            k=0
            while k<len(row) and row[k]==first:
                k+=1
            if k<len(row):
                out[r][k:]=[1]*(len(row)-k)
    return out

demo_in=[[4]*20,[4]*20,[8]*20]+[[4]*20 for _ in range(6)]+[[8]*16+[4]*4]+[[4]*20 for _ in range(4)]
demo_out=[row[:] for row in demo_in]
demo_out[9][16:]=[1]*4
print('demo reproduced:', transform(demo_in)==demo_out)
test=[[3]*13,[6]*13,[3]*13,[6]*13,[3]*11+[6]*2,[6]*13,[6]*13,[6]*13,[3]*8+[6]*5,[6]*13]
result=transform(test)
print(result)

print('saved', path)
